style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontSize=11;" value="Reading this diagram

There is exactly one consumer in the platform today, P5. Every other arrow into a store is a write. The four ingestion processes never read back what they wrote, and their Kafka policies deny it: a write-only identity that can read its own topic is not write-only, and each producer has a test that proves the denial.

D7 is the honest gap. The store exists, the writer exists, and what it writes goes to a log line rather than to object storage with a signed manifest." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="560" x="40" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Reading this diagram
There is exactly one consumer in the platform today, P5. Every other arrow into a store is a write. The four ingestion processes never read back what they wrote, and their Kafka policies deny it: a write-only identity that can read its own topic is not write-only, and each producer has a test that proves the denial.
D7 is the honest gap. The store exists, the writer exists, and what it writes goes to a log line rather than to object storage with a signed manifest.
